testimonials.name: Sutharshan Rajendran
testimonials.content: Mr. Achchuthan's teaching methodology transformed my understanding of software engineering. His real-world project examples and hands-on approach prepared me exceptionally well for my career. The Student Information System project he mentored became a cornerstone of my portfolio.

testimonials.name: Priyanka Sivakumar
testimonials.content: The Web Technologies course taught by Mr. Achchuthan gave me industry-relevant skills that I use daily in my professional work. His passion for teaching and deep technical knowledge created an inspiring learning environment. Highly recommend his courses to any aspiring developer.

testimonials.name: Kavitha Sivarajah
testimonials.content: Mr. Achchuthan's courses combine theoretical depth with practical application perfectly. His feedback on assignments was always constructive and helped me grow as a developer. The skills I learned continue to be relevant in my professional work.

testimonials.name: Dr. Mahendran Rathakrishnan
testimonials.content: Achchuthan is an exceptional colleague who brings both technical excellence and pedagogical innovation to our department.
